findings.title: speaker assigns status-lowering agency to the Lord
findings.claim: {{ar:أَهَٰنَنِ}} ({{tr:ahānani}}) is not a generic hardship word.
findings.mechanism: {{ar:أَهَٰنَنِ}} ({{tr:ahānani}}) is not a generic hardship word. Its Form IV causative structure makes the speaker claim that his Lord has actively lowered him, and the first-person object makes the verdict about personal rank. The perfect form states the humiliation as a completed fact, while the root range moves from lightness and low weight into dishonor; the quote selects the status-lowering edge of that field. The clipped written ending and fuller recitational forms both keep the same me-object, tightening self-reference at the ayah's close. Here speech, lordship, and humiliation converge as a spoken accusation, not just as adjacent vocabulary. As the inverse of the honor claim in 89:15, the final word leaves the human diagnosis exposed for the rejection that follows at 89:17.

findings.title: singular suffix form presents a bounded share
findings.claim: {{ar:رِزْقَهُۥ}} ({{tr:rizqahu}}) names the resource-domain that is being measured.
findings.mechanism: {{ar:رِزْقَهُۥ}} ({{tr:rizqahu}}) names the resource-domain that is being measured. The suffix makes it his allotted provision, which explains the temptation to read the restriction as self-devaluation; yet the syntax keeps it as an object measured by another, not a possession under the human's control. The singular suffixed form presents one bounded share under measure rather than an open field under the human's control. The root range is wider than cash: sustaining supply, benefit, livelihood, and allotment all sit under the provider's domain. The measured-provision construction in 65:7 strengthens that restricted supply can belong to obligation and apportionment, not automatic dishonor. Because the object comes after {{ar:عَلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhi}}), the felt pressure arrives before the resource is named, and the later complaint turns the Sustainer's own domain into evidence for a status verdict. The word also supplies the resource-domain through which the prior prosperity scene (89:15) can be reread.
